Fresh Fruit Salad
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




2 pints sliced strawberries
2 sliced ripe bananas
2 Granny smith or other tart apples, sliced
1 cup seedless table grapes
juice of one large lemon
3 tablespoons honey

Preparation

1 Mix fruit together in large glass or ceramic bowl. Pour lemon juice over fruit, add honey and mix together well. Refrigerate for about an hour and stir again before serving.
